page_title: BET 0-2 RSO | Betis v Real Sociedad 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+1' Nabil Fekir (Betis) is booked for saying more than Juan Martinez Munuera was willing to tolerate.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
83' The yellow card goes to Juan Miranda (Betis). Juan Miranda (Betis) behaves unsportingly.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Sheraldo Becker.
81' The goal by Betis is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
81' Wait! Referee Juan Martinez Munuera has indicated he is going to review the Betis goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
79' Ayoze Perez (Betis) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom left corner.
79' The attendance is 58036.
78' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
76' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) replaces Hamari Traore.
76' A substitution has been made. Brais Mendez goes off and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) comes on.
74' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
71' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
71' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Free kick. Real Sociedad will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
71' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Kieran Tierney and he is replaced by Jon Martin (Real Sociedad).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benat Turrientes leaves the pitch and Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) comes on.
66' Penalty saved! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Alex Remiro pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
63' The referee blows his whistle as Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge. Betis are awarded a penalty!
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
60' Here is a change. Youssouf Sabaly is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Hector Bellerin (Betis).
59' The manager makes a subsitution with Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) coming on for Willian Jose.
58' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) gets a yellow card. Juan Martinez Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Youssouf Sabaly (Betis). A free kick to Real Sociedad.

52' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Betis. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
52' Foul! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Betis have a free kick.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a half-time substitution. Sergi Altimira (Betis) comes on in place of Pablo Fornals.
46' Half-time substitution. William Carvalho (Betis) will not participate anymore and Rodri is coming on.
46' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' 0 - 2 Goal Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad)! Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) was put through by Mikel Oyarzabal and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
38' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
37' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

36' CLOSE! Nabil Fekir (Betis) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

36' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle after Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to Betis, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
33' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
32' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' It seemed like Nabil Fekir (Betis) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

31' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Martinez Munuera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Betis win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

31' What a great touch by Ayoze Perez (Betis) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

28' Pablo Fornals (Betis) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Pablo Fornals (Betis) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
24' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Betis will take a free kick.
22' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' William Carvalho (Betis) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad will take a free kick near the side line.
19' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick.
19' Alex Remiro pulls off a great save to deny Nabil Fekir (Betis), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
17' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Betis have been awarded a free kick.
15' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Betis have a free kick.
12' None of the Betis players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
9' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) touches the ball with his hand. Betis are awarded the free kick.

5' 0 - 1 Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top right corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 0:1.
4' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
1' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Betis in a dangerous position.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Betis will take the kick-off.
